mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(pw.point_balance, 0) AS currentPoint FROM user_tbl AS user LEFT OUTER JOIN point_wallet_tbl AS pw ON user.user_id = pw.user_id WHERE user.user_id = #{userId} AND user.user_status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(ecu.current_level, 1) AS challengeLevel , IFNULL(ecu.current_target, 0) AS challengeExe , CASE WHEN ecu.challenge_id IS NULL THEN 1000 ELSE ec.max_target END AS challengeMaxExe , DATE_FORMAT(ec.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS challengeStartAt , DATE_FORMAT(ec.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS challengeEndAt FROM event_challenge_tbl AS ec LEFT OUTER JOIN event_challenge_user_tbl AS ecu ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecu.user_id = #{userId} # WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date ORDER BY ecu.current_level DESC LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_participation_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_attendance_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_challenge_user_tbl (challenge_id, user_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_reward_receive_tbl (event_id, reward_id, user_id, received_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{rewardId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_challenge_user_tbl (user_id, challenge_id, status, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{challengeId}, 'COMPLETE', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'COMPLETE', updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: INSERT INTO point_transaction_tbl (point_wallet_id, transaction_type, point_amount, reason_type, created_at) VALUES ( #{pointWalletId}, #{transactionType}, #{pointAmount}, #{reasonType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl SET current_target = current_target + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PROCESS'
mapper.select: # SELECT COUNT(*) # FROM ( # SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_participation_tbl # WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(participated_at) = CURDATE() # UNION ALL # SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_attendance_tbl # WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(participated_at) = CURDATE() # ) AS today_part

select a.event_id, a.event_name, a.event_desc, a.event_type, a.event_status, a.event_img_name, a.event_target, a.event_level, a.event_daily_limit_count, a.start_at, a.end_at,
b.reward_id, b.reward_point, b.reward_exe,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id ) AS currentTargetCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id ) >= a.event_target AS completed,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND err.event_id = a.event_id ) AS rewardReceived,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_user_tbl eu WHERE eu.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.event_id = a.event_id ) AS joined
from event_tbl a left join event_reward_tbl b on a.event_id = b.event_id WHERE a.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' ORDER BY a.created_at desc;

select a.event_id, a.event_name, a.event_desc, a.event_type, a.event_status, a.event_img_name, a.event_target, a.event_level, a.event_daily_limit_count, a.start_at, a.end_at,
b.reward_id, b.reward_point, b.reward_exe,
(a.event_daily_limit_count > 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id AND DATE(ep.participated_at) = CURDATE() ) >= a.event_daily_limit_count ) AS isDailyLimitReached,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = a.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(ea.participated_at) = CURDATE() ) AS todayAttendanceCompleted,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.event_id = a.event_id ) AS currentTargetCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.event_id = a.event_id ) >= a.event_target AS completed,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND err.event_id = a.event_id ) AS rewardReceived
from event_tbl a left join event_reward_tbl b on a.event_id = b.event_id WHERE a.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' ORDER BY a.created_at desc;

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId , e.event_name AS eventName , e.event_desc AS eventDesc , e.event_type AS eventType , e.event_img_name AS eventImgName , er.reward_id AS rewardId , err.recv_id AS recvId , DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS receivedAt , IFNULL(er.reward_point,0) AS rewardPoint , IFNULL(er.reward_exe,0) AS rewardExe FROM event_reward_receive_tbl AS err INNER JOIN event_tbl AS e ON err.event_id = e.event_id LEFT OUTER JOIN event_reward_tbl AS er ON err.event_id = er.event_id AND err.reward_id = er.reward_id WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY err.received_at DESC
